threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep asking for directions to the 'nearest tube' but you're in Dalston—it's all buses and overground. Tube? Good luck!
Caught a guy serenading the night bus with an old Elvis tune, while the driver just rolled his eyes. Only in Brixton, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I realized I was really home was when I heard a kid arguing with their parent in Turkish while a street musician played on a nearby corner. Perfect Neukölln vibe.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a currywurst stand next to a vintage vinyl shop, blasting techno while locals debate philosophy over street art.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a real local when they instinctively know to avoid 16th St BART around 5 PM. That’s not just traffic; it’s chaos.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenade the 19 bus passengers with a ukulele rendition of 'I Will Survive' while juggling three oranges. Classic Tenderloin.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is all about the plazas, but it’s the small bakeries tucked away on side streets that really serve the heart of the community.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by how they order 'café amb llet' instead of just coffee. Still trying to impress the barista, poor things.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still avoid the cracks in the pavement like they're landmines, but locals just strut right over them without a care.
Caught a guy on the 59 last night arguing with his reflection in the window. Must've thought he was on stage; real showman vibes.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw an older couple doing tango in the park, surrounded by kids on swings and local artists painting nearby. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find spontaneous parties in the park, complete with DJs and drumming circles—just a regular Sunday vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they can name the bus line that’s always late, yet still choose to wait for it instead of using the BART chaos.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a pigeon hop onto a Muni bus, ride halfway, then strut off like it owned the place. Classic SF moment—wildlife and transit, all in one.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think it's all about Gaudí, but the real heart of Gràcia beats in the small plaça bars where locals gather for vermut, not selfies.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they ask for directions to Casa Ramos and look baffled when locals suggest they just wander around.
